entities.summary: Sophiko Shevardnadze (b. 1978-09-23, Tbilisi) was a social reformer or activist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tbilisi and Georgia. Known in the fields of georgia, activists & reformers, asia.
